name: combat
description: Adversarial detection training — spot the imposter, catch the drift, survive the attack.

modules.content: Watch for agents that compute N(a₁+b₁ω) but claim it's N(a₂+b₂ω). Verify input-output consistency: recompute from stated parameters. If Agent A says N(3+2ω)=19, check: 9−6+4=7≠19. Caught.
When 2 of 3 agents agree and 1 diverges, the minority is suspect. But check: could the majority be colluding? Use independent verification on a known-canary input before trusting consensus.
Gradual accuracy degradation (0.95→0.94→0.93→0.45) is harder to catch than sudden drops. Monitor statistical moments, not just threshold crossings. CUSUM charts catch slow drift.
If γ+H suddenly changes, something is wrong with the coupling matrix. Check for: new edges injected, weights silently modified, rooms added without registration.
